Count objects by kind with optional filtering.

This command reports object counts (optionally scoped by namespace).



When no kind is specified, counts public registry kinds (visibility≠internal),

matching bare object list. Intentional exclusions are recorded in JSON/YAML meta

(skipped_internal_*, omitted_zero_count_kinds, find_vs_count_recipe).

Full inventory: object count --internal (entitled) and/or --include-zero-count,

or object count <kind> for a named kind (including internals).

  Count all backlog items
  zqk.test count backlog_item
  Count with filtering
  zqk.test count backlog_item --filter status=exploring
  Count all kinds
  zqk.test count
  Count all kinds including visibility:internal (entitled)
  zqk.test count --internal
  Include zero-count kinds in the inventory
  zqk.test count --include-zero-count
  Count with grouping
  zqk.test count backlog_item --group-by status
  Count a specific namespace
  zqk.test count team --namespace tenant:acme
  Count across namespaces
  zqk.test count team --federated

Usage:
  zqk.test object count [flags]

Flags:
      --all-kinds            Show full registered kind catalog (bypass planner/doer discovery membrane)
      --all-namespaces       Alias for --federated
      --allow-degraded       Allow running when scheduler daemon is not running (results may be partial/stale)
      --federated            Disable namespace isolation and count across all namespaces
      --filter stringArray   Filter by field (format: field=value or field:value, can be used multiple times)
      --group-by string      Field to group counts by (returns count per group)
      --include-zero-count   Include kinds with 0 objects (default omits them to reduce noise)
      --namespace string     Restrict counts to this namespace_id (when omitted, default kernel isolation applies)

Global Flags:
      --internal   Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
